Ohio High School Football

2026-08-02: Tentative 2026 schedules have been posted! Coaches / ADs, please notify me at joe@joeeitel.com if your scheduled games or dates have changed or are otherwise not accurately reflected. Additionally, please ensure all games are properly entered in DragonFly.
Out of state divisional classifications and non-rated game indicators will be updated later in August.

I expect Glenville and Youngstown to be officially assigned to a division and region on or near September 10 per OHSAA bylaws. Until then, I may estimate an unofficial division and region on this website as needed.
